lineItems.subCategory: Wall Punning SKU : Custom wallpaper Description : Scope of Work: Custom Wallpaper with Base Preparation Scope: Supply and installation of customized wallpaper as per approved design selection, including necessary wall surface preparation to ensure a smooth and even finish. The work includes proper alignment and pasting of wallpaper to achieve a seamless appearance. Surface preparation shall include wall leveling with putty and application of primer prior to installation. Installation charges are included in the scope. Materials: Wallpaper: Customized wallpaper as per approved design selection (coverage up to 50 sqft per roll) Putty: 2 coats for surface leveling Primer: 1 coat oil-based primer Base Rate: Customized Wallpaper: Base Rate Rs. 140 per sqft + GST (50sqft Coverage / Roll) Note: Installation included. Scaffolding charges shall be extra, if required. Standard flat-finish wallpaper only is considered in this scope. 3D effect, embossed, textured, metallic, or specialty wallpapers are not included in the base rate. Additional charges shall apply for such selections.

lineItems.subCategory: PCC SKU : Safety door_Laminate finish (SF)/Satin Enamel Finish_ 3.5 x 7 door size Description : "Scope of Work Providing and installation of Safty door of blockboard upto 35mm and including with 12mm mdf for groove design on front side. Inner room side door to be finished in SF laminate of 1mm thickness on with proper alignment including cutting and pasting of laminate installation of hard wares and safety grill (10mmx10mm solid square bar to be used)as per design and with groove provisions on single/Front side as per design and finish with satin enamel paint. safety door to be fixed in existing frame with groove cutting and groove  to be finish with the satin enamel paint  .  Inclusions.Blockboard MR -A grade / Plyneer • SF Laminate 2000/-rs +GST sheet • SS Plantex butt hinges 14 gauge 4""X3""X3"" • Consumables (Screws, Tape, Sandpaper) included • Including hand Paint / hand polish on edges/dhar. • Hardware and accesories (except hinges & MS jali) in Cx scope.Only installation of hardware's is included in the cost. • Complete installation with proper alignment. • Manual loading & unloading of material is included up to the 3rd floor, with or without lift access.. Exclusions • Any design elements like T Patti, CNC patterns, fluting or metallic inlays will be charged extra. • Manual loading & unloading from 4th floor onwards will be charged extra. • Any scaffolding requirements will be charged extra. Brand of Material • Laminate: Merino / Greenlam"
